zh.text: 私有產權

en.text: Which of the following statements about private property rights is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪一項關於私有產權的陳述是正確的？

en.text: Private property rights may still exist without a court of law.

zh.text: 即使沒有法庭，私有產權可能仍然存在。

en.text: Private property rights may be protected by local customs.

zh.text: 私有產權可受地方習俗保護。

en.text: Private property rights are an essential prelude for market transactions.

zh.text: 私有產權是市場交易的必要前奏。
以上皆是
香港高級程度會考 2010 卷一 第 20 題

en.text: Marlene had bought a cookery book from a bookstore. Her friend, Kitman, said to her, “You have private property rights to this cookery book.” Which of the following rights would Marlene have after the purchase of the book?

zh.text: 瑪蓮從書店購買了一本烹飪書。她的朋友潔文告訴她：「你擁有這烹飪書的私有產權。」瑪蓮在購入該書後會擁有哪些權利？

en.text: To follow the recipes in the book in preparing a dinner for Kitman

zh.text: 按書中的食譜，為潔文準備晚餐。

en.text: To scan and upload the whole book to her blog

zh.text: 把整本書掃描並上載到她的網誌。

en.text: To leave the book on the bookshelf without reading it

zh.text: 把書放在書架，不去閱讀它。

en.text: To lend the book to Kitman and ask for a dinner in return

zh.text: 把書借給潔文，並要求一頓晚餐作回報。
香港中學文憑考試 2016 卷一 第 5 題

en.text: Refer to the following suggestion for tackling the housing problem.

zh.text: 參考以下解決房屋問題的建議：

en.text: The government should build a new type of housing, called Easy Living, for which the owners can lease their flats at a controlled rent. If the owners want to sell their flats, they can only sell them back to the government.

zh.text: 政府應該興建一種新類型的房屋「居住易」，其業主能以一受管制的租金出租其單位。若業主想出售其物業，他們只能將單位售回政府。

en.text: Compared with owning a private housing unit, __________ will be weakened for those owning an Easy Living housing unit.

zh.text: 與擁有一個私人樓宇單位相比，擁有一個「居住易」單位的業主的 ______ 會被削弱了。
使用權
賺取收入權
轉讓權
香港中學文憑考試 2019 卷一 第 1 題

en.text: A band in Hong Kong adopted a real-name registration system for the sale of its concert tickets. These tickets were not transferrable so that the chance of ticket scalping (炒賣) was reduced.

zh.text: 一支香港樂隊採用了實名登記制發售其演唱會門票。這些門票不可轉讓，所以炒賣的機會減少。

en.text: Which of the following statements about the above real-name registration system is/are correct?

zh.text: 以下哪項／哪些有關上述實名登記制的陳述是正確的？
只有 (1)
只有 (2)
只有 (3)

en.text: It is a mechanism to tackle the problem of ‘what to produce’.

zh.text: 這是解決「生產什麼」的問題的一個機制。

en.text: The private property rights over the tickets would be weakened under the system.

zh.text: 在該機制下，門票的私有產權會被削弱。

en.text: Non-price competition would not be involved in the allocation of the tickets under the system.

zh.text: 在該機制下，門票的分配並不涉及非價格競爭。
香港中學文憑考試 2023 卷一 第 3 題

en.text: When private property rights are weakened, ___________.

zh.text: 當私有產權被削弱時，________。

en.text: resources are less likely to be allocated to their highest-valued use

zh.text: 資源被分配到其最高價值的用途的可能性較低

en.text: income derived from assets is likely to decrease

zh.text: 從資產所衍生的收入很可能減少

en.text: non-price competition is more likely to arise

zh.text: 非價格競爭較有可能出現
香港中學文憑考試 2024 卷一 第 4 題
